plugins.name: card-buyer
plugins.description: Requisition Magic the Gathering cards by adding them to the user's online carts at their local game stores in priority order (from CARD_STORES), then TCGPlayer for whatever is left.

plugins.name: mtg-add-cards
plugins.description: Add Magic: The Gathering cards to the user's collection.

plugins.name: mtg-api
plugins.description: Read or change the user's Magic: The Gathering collection through the MTG REST API, which is the single source of truth for every card they own and every deck they have built.

plugins.name: mtg-build-deck
plugins.description: Build a Magic: The Gathering Commander deck for the user out of the cards they own but has not committed to a deck.

plugins.name: mtg-remove-cards
plugins.description: Remove Magic: The Gathering cards from the user's collection.

plugins.name: mtg-system
plugins.description: Understand, diagnose and safely modify the machinery behind the user's MTG collection — the Cloudflare Worker, the D1 database, the web frontend, the daily maintenance job and the backups.

metadata.description: Claude Code skills for managing a Magic: The Gathering collection through an MTG API deployment, building decks from it, and buying cards from local stores.
